[SWS_CM_90470] E2E protection header according to the network binding in the
method response
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00400, RS_E2E_08541
⌈
For E2E-protected
Method
responses, the E2E protection header shall be added to
the message. If the protocol specification of the respective network binding imposes
restrictions on the placement of the E2E protection header (e.g., [PRS_SOMEIP_-
00941] in case of SOME/IP network binding), then these restrictions shall be honored.
⌋
